coordinator_sequence: wait HELLO from B and C exactly
emit ACK round 0 to B and C
for rounds 1..5 wait READY pair, emit START pair, wait DONE pair, validate DONE rc/result, record end_after_both_done_ns, emit ACK pair
done_validation: DONE must have status PASS, rc 0, and result passing validate_io_result(seq-read, close).
name: afs.dfs_manyread.sync_stdio.v1
reader_sequence: wait ACK round 0 before DFS precheck/warmup
READY after precheck and warmup for each measured round
DONE after C seq-read result and sample artifact write
wait ACK round n before next READY or final fullSHA/EOF verification
FINAL after ACK5 and final verification
stable_handshake: HELLO -> ACK0 -> READY -> START -> DONE -> ACKn -> FINAL
terminal_events: Readers terminate after FINAL; coordinator returns DATA_RECORDED after FINAL pair. Parent relay should close reader stdin after coordinator ACK5/reader FINAL exchange and preserve each process argv/stdout/stderr/rc.
timing: ctl Linux monotonic_ns; per-round elapsed starts before START emit and ends after both DONE events, including host relay/Lima control delay plus reader result write/emit overhead; ACK/final SHA/EOF are outside measured round window.
